title: Prediction-powered Inference by Mixture of Experts
one_line_what_it_does: PPI with K predictors; mixture weights chosen to minimise variance (global weights), best-expert guarantee, non-asymptotic coverage bounds; i.i.d. units, weights estimated on the same labeled data
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: combination weights over a menu of predictors (part 2: optimal combination); no clusters, no few-unit regime

title: Multi-Source Prediction-Powered Inference
one_line_what_it_does: Aggregates several pseudo-labelled datasets/ML methods with weights minimising asymptotic confidence-region volume; asymptotic normality, oracle-volume equivalence; cross-fitting only for shift nuisances
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: optimal combination of predictors; i.i.d., asymptotic; no clusters

title: Multiple-Prediction-Powered Inference (MultiPPI)
authors: Cowen-Breen, Agarwal, Bates, Cohen, Eisenstein, Globerson
one_line_what_it_does: Cost-aware generalisation of PPI++ to multiple predictors; chooses which predictor subsets to run and linear weights by SOCP; minimax-optimal; finite-sample bounds when covariance is estimated (shrinkage)
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: multi-predictor PPI++ with weights and covariance estimation from few labels; i.i.d. units, cost allocation rather than inference validity after selection

title: Active Multiple-Prediction-Powered Inference (AM-PPI)
one_line_what_it_does: Per-instance routing to predictor subset, label sampling and weighting under budget; asymptotic normality, min-variance within AIPW class
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: multi-predictor PPI weights and subset choice; asymptotic i.i.d.; no clusters

title: SADA: Safe and Adaptive Aggregation of Multiple Black-Box Predictions in Semi-Supervised Learning
one_line_what_it_does: Aggregates multiple black-box predictions; never worse than labeled-only; adaptive efficiency if one predictor is perfect; R package
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: combination of several predictors with safety guarantee; i.i.d., asymptotic

title: Conditional validity of prediction-powered inference for spatially dependent finite populations
one_line_what_it_does: Theorem 1 + Supplement S3.2: same-label selection from a fixed finite library of calibration candidates is asymptotically harmless when candidate influence functions coalesce (max over candidates of influence differences ->0); explicitly no finite-sample or unrestricted-tuning claim
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: post-selection validity over a finite menu, but only in the asymptotic regime where candidates are asymptotically indistinguishable; no few-cluster, no genuinely different predictors. Unpublished preprint

title: Cluster-Robust Prediction-Powered Inference
one_line_what_it_does: Cluster-robust PPI++ with partially labelled clusters, cluster-aware power tuning; asymptotic
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: clusters (already listed as prior art); single predictor

title: Conformal prediction after data-dependent model selection
one_line_what_it_does: Finite-sample valid conformal sets after selecting, on the same hold-out data, the model giving the shortest set, without further splitting
bears_on_which_part_of_claim: direct conformal analogue of same-label selection among a model menu; template for a PPI version; no PPI, no clusters

title: Valid Selection among Conformal Sets

bears_on_which_part_of_claim: analogue: select smallest interval among K valid intervals; tool (algorithmic stability) transferable
